title: DC's PVP
description: Optimized PVP pack for Minecraft 1.21.11. Integrates Sodium and Lithium for smoother performance, with adjusted combat mechanics for stable multiplayer gameplay
body: DC's PVP v1.0.0 works with Minecraft 1.21.11. This is a high-performance integrated pack made for competitive PVP. It is optimized for network latency and frame rate to support multiplayer combat. The pack adjusts damage feedback, knockback effects and weapon balance for battles. It includes optimization mods like Sodium and Lithium to improve rendering, server operation and entity rendering. Automatic frame rate adjustment is available.
